title: Study to Assess the Effect of Branebrutinib on the Drug Levels of Rosuvastatin in Healthy Participants

sections.abstract: The purpose of this study is to examine the interaction of branebrutinib with rosuvastatin. Rosuvastatin is a substrate of the breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP) transporter, which has a drug level profile that can be markedly altered by coadministration of known inhibitors of the BCRP transporter. With widespread use of statins as cholesterol-lowering agents, rosuvastatin is also a likely concomitant drug for participants who would potentially be treated with branebrutinib.
